# botyard_bot_member_bot (Resource)

Makes one bot a member of another bot.

**Non-authoritative.** Each resource manages exactly one member bot and ignores every other row on the list, so member bots added in the Botyard app never show up as drift. Declare one resource per member bot; several on the same bot apply safely in parallel.

**Existing rows are adopted.** Creating this resource for a bot that is already a member takes that row over and sets its `role`. Destroying the resource removes the row, whoever created it.

**Who may change members.** Only an owner of the bot named by `bot_slug` can change its member bots. An API key owns only the bots it created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Make one bot a member of another, e.g. so a coordinator bot can reach a
# restricted worker bot.
resource "botyard_bot_member_bot" "coordinator" {
  bot_slug      = botyard_bot.worker.slug
  member_bot_id = botyard_bot.coordinator.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_slug` (String) Slug of the bot whose member list this row is on, e.g. `botyard_bot.x.slug`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `member_bot_id` (String) ID of the member bot, e.g. `botyard_bot.y.id`. It must be a live bot in the same organization, other than the bot itself. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `role` (String) `member` or `owner`. Defaults to `member`. Updated in place. The role is recorded only: Botyard does not yet grant a member bot any permission from it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the membership was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Resource identifier: `{bot_slug}/{member_bot_id}`.
- `member_bot_name` (String) Display name of the member bot.
- `member_bot_slug` (String) Slug of the member bot.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Member bots are imported by `{bot_slug}/{member_bot_id}`.
terraform import botyard_bot_member_bot.coordinator worker/7d1e4b2a-3c5f-4a6b-9e8d-1f2a3b4c5d6e
```
